item.title: (Effortpost) Inevitably of a post-graphics era
item.description:
>Diminishing returns for exponential budgets and more years of dev time, to the point of some studios missing a whole gen thats already 7 years long
>Games w/ 5 mil copies sold arent considered profitable now
>Kids play roblox and fortnite, CSGO was one of the most popular mp games in 2022 despite looking outdated even in 2012. Indie games are doing the ps1 low poly look. Normies think ps4 fifa looks the sam
